name: GhostTable
description: Headless native table root. Optional horizontal scroll containment; sub-parts supply caption, sections, rows, and cells. Themed styles live on @ghostvue/themes GhostTable.

props.name: containHorizontal
props.description: When true, wraps the table in a scroll container for explicit horizontal overflow. The table itself never receives implicit overflow.

slots.name: default
slots.description: GhostTableCaption, GhostTableHead, GhostTableBody, and GhostTableFoot content.

exposed.name: element
exposed.description: The native table after mount, or null before mount and after unmount.

parts.name: scroll-container
parts.description: Optional wrapper when containHorizontal is true.
